cur-fossil-dera-bugti.dateNote: In 1907–08 the geologist Guy Pilgrim found jaws and teeth in the Bugti Hills of Balochistan, Pakistan. They were later named Paraceratherium, one of the largest land mammals ever. The rock is about 30–23 million years old (Oligocene). Pinned on the town of Dera Bugti; the fossil beds are in the hills around it.
cur-fossil-dera-bugti.summary: Where the first fossils of Paraceratherium, a giant hornless rhino, were found.
